name: floorplan
short: Browse and load Pixel Index office layouts
description: Owns Pixel Index API/Web endpoint configuration, catalogue search and detail browsing, and loading a selected layout through pixelagents into the Discord CCTV aggregate.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any data or metadata about users. It stores only bot-wide Pixel Index API and web endpoint URLs.
install_msg: Requires corridor and pixelagents (both auto-loaded). Use [p]floorplan index to configure Pixel Index and [p]floorplan layout to browse layouts.
author: Pixel Agents HQ Contributors
